# BarcodeSymbology

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The 1D barcode symbologies supported natively by BonniePDF. These four cover retail (EAN-13, UPC-A) and logistics (Code 128, ITF-14) across the UK, EU, and US. Additional symbologies (Code 39/93, DataMatrix, PDF417, Aztec, …) are provided by the optional extension package.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Code128`: Code 128 (ISO/IEC 15417) - the universal logistics barcode. Full ASCII.
- `Ean13`: EAN-13 (ISO/IEC 15420) - the EU/UK retail product barcode. 12 digits + check.
- `UpcA`: UPC-A (ISO/IEC 15420) - the US/Canada retail product barcode. 11 digits + check.
- `Itf14`: ITF-14 (ISO/IEC 16390 + GS1) - the outer-case/shipping barcode. 13 digits + check.
